notes.title: PROLOGUE IS OUT ON AUGUST 6th!
notes.notes:
Hello explorers of the BackRooms: No Return!, we are here to announce that on Tuesday, August 6th, we will release the Prologue of Backrooms No Return, where you can play a part of the game before the full release with puzzles, cinematics and a lot of mysteries.

We hope you like it and we are open to any kind of feedback. Thank you very much!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2866360/BACKROOMS_NO_RETURN_Prologue/

notes.title: UPDATE BACKROOMS: NO RETURN
notes.notes:
Greetings, explorers of the BackRooms: No Return! We have a thrilling update to share with you straight from our development team.

What's Ahead:

An update to our demo is on the horizon, packed with fresh mysteries and unseen depths of the BackRooms. Get ready to dive back in and uncover secrets untold!

Your Feedback Matters:

Your experiences guide our journey. Keep sharing your thoughts, and together, we'll shape the BackRooms into an unforgettable adventure.

Stay Tuned:

Prepare for the next phase of exploration! We're thrilled to announce that we're nearing the completion of the full game. Your unwavering support has fueled our progress, and we can't wait to unveil the complete BackRooms experience to you soon.

Adventure Awaits!

FriedGPU Team

notes.title: BACKROOMS: NO RETURN DEMO LAUNCH TODAY!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce the launch of  Backrooms: No Return DEMO on Steam.

We invite you to join us on this thrilling adventure and look forward to hearing your thoughts and feedback on the game. Thank you for your support and we hope you have a great time playing Backrooms: No Return!

We also want to assure you that we are constantly working on improving the game, whether it be through bug fixes, new content, or overall gameplay enhancements. Our team is dedicated to providing you with the best possible experience, and we appreciate your support and understanding as we work towards achieving that goal.

Sincerely,

The Backrooms: No Return Development Team
